name: [UPDATE] La Peace Obby
desc:
LA PEACE OBBY 🗣️🔥  

Kai and IShowSpeed went searching for diamonds...

But they found something more valuable.  
LA PEACE.  

Complete 110 chaotic stages, dodge lava and traps, and reach the end to find La Peace.  

💾 Your progress saves automatically
👥 Play with friends
🔓 Discover secret levels and rewards  

But don't expect it to be easy.

La Peace has its price.  

Would you dare to pay it?
